title.zh: 持有超200万枚$SOL（约2.2亿美元）的SkyAI疑似正在亏损抛售$SOL！
title.en: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!

current_state.zh: SkyAI 仍在持续清算其 SOL 储备：已披露出售 100 万枚 SOL 套现约 1.07 亿美元，链上自 10 月初以来累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），8-K 显示持仓已降至约 60 万枚，按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元；公司 10 月 11 日宣布每股 3.00 美元现金要约收购以回购 95% 股份，但大股东 Bastion Trading 公开反对并要求全面披露、独立审查、改组董事会及提高要约价至至少 3.50 美元。
current_state.en: SkyAI remains in an ongoing SOL liquidation: it disclosed selling 1M SOL for about $107M, on-chain outflows since early October total about 1.57M SOL (~$175M), an 8-K shows holdings down to ~600K SOL, with unrealized losses over $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis; its Oct 11 $3.00/share cash tender offer to buy back 95% of shares is now publicly opposed by 9.99% holder Bastion Trading, which demands full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher price of at least $3.50/share.

updates.title_zh: 持有超200万枚$SOL（约2.2亿美元）的SkyAI疑似正在亏损抛售$SOL！
updates.title_en: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!
updates.what_changed_zh:
链上数据显示，持有超过200万枚SOL（约合2.2亿美元）的SkyAI在过去三天内向交易所转入了56.8万枚SOL（约合6387万美元）。其平均买入价约为194美元，若这些代币被卖出，预计将产生约4600万美元的亏损。

这一转账规模让SOL交易者关注到一个大型单一持有者的潜在抛压，不过抛售行为是根据转入交易所的资金流推断的，并未得到该实体的确认。

该观察涵盖三天内合计56.8万枚SOL的转账，对应其披露的约194美元平均买入成本；4600万美元的亏损为基于该成本价的估算，只有在代币实际卖出时才会兑现。
updates.what_changed_en: On-chain data shows SkyAI, a holder of over 2M SOL (~$220M), has moved 568,000 SOL (~$63.87M) to exchanges in three days, apparently realizing a loss of roughly $46M against a ~$194 average entry.

updates.background_zh: 加密货币媒体报道称，SkyAI是Solana生态中持有大量SOL的知名大户。此次转账信息来自Arkham Intelligence——一个对链上实体进行标注和追踪的公开区块链浏览器与分析平台。链上分析师普遍将“转入交易所”视为可能抛售的代理指标，但这本身并不能证明卖出现已发生。
updates.background_en: SkyAI is described in crypto media coverage as a prominent holder in the Solana ecosystem managing significant amounts of SOL. The transfer was surfaced through Arkham Intelligence, a public blockchain explorer and analytics platform that labels and tracks on-chain entities. Exchange inflows are widely used by on-chain analysts as a proxy for possible selling, but they do not by themselves prove that a sale occurred.
updates.market_impact_zh: 相关传导渠道是SOL现货与衍生品交易所的订单簿流动性：若56.8万枚SOL被实际卖出，将构成潜在的近期卖盘供给，同时也可能影响市场对大户持仓动向的短期情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: The relevant channel is order-book liquidity on SOL spot and derivatives venues: a 568,000 SOL inflow represents potential near-term sell-side supply if it is executed, which can also feed into short-term sentiment around large-holder positioning.

references.title: SkyAI’s Transfer of 568,000 SOL Raises Concerns Over Market

updates.title_zh: 🔍  链上侦探 |  SOL财库公司SkyAI正清算其SOL储备，5天累计卖出约125万枚SOL
updates.title_en: 🔍  链上侦探 |  SOL财库公司SkyAI正清算其SOL储备，5天累计卖出约125万枚SOL
updates.what_changed_zh: SkyAI 被监测到正在清算其 SOL 储备，近5天累计卖出约125万枚 SOL（约1.38亿美元），其中包括约半小时前将211,623枚 SOL 转入 Coinbase Prime；公司公告称此次出售是为了回购其已发行股份的95%。
updates.what_changed_en: SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, having sold roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days, including a 211,623 SOL transfer to Coinbase Prime; the company announced the sale is to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.current_state_zh: SkyAI 正在清算 SOL 储备，近5天累计卖出约125万枚 SOL（约1.38亿美元），以回购其95%的已发行股份。
updates.current_state_en: SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, having sold roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nasdaq-listed SOL treasury firm SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, selling roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days — including a 211,623 SOL transfer to Coinbase Prime — to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nasdaq-listed SOL treasury firm SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, selling roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days — including a 211,623 SOL transfer to Coinbase Prime — to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.background_zh: SkyAI, Inc.（纳斯达克代码：SKYA）前身为 Sharps Technology, Inc.，自称在为全球南方构建 Agentic Finance，并在完成 4.11 亿美元 PIPE 融资的同时采用了基于 Solana 的财库策略。据 The Block 报道，目前规模最大的 SOL 财库公司 Forward 自 6 月中旬起寻求收购 SkyAI，在 SkyAI 拒绝其首次报价后，于 9 月 15 日提交了更新后的收购提案。
updates.background_en: SkyAI, Inc. (Nasdaq: SKYA), formerly Sharps Technology, Inc., describes itself as building Agentic Finance for the Global South and adopted a Solana-based treasury strategy alongside a $411 million PIPE financing. The Block has reported that Forward, currently the largest Solana treasury company, has been seeking to acquire SkyAI since mid-June, submitting an updated purchase proposal on Sept. 15 after SkyAI rejected its first offer.
updates.market_impact_zh: 相关转账经由面向机构的交易与托管平台 Coinbase Prime 进行，因此这约 125 万枚 SOL 构成短期内规模较大且集中的 SOL 卖方供给。此次减持也会影响市场对数字资产财库（DAT）模式的情绪，其他上市的 SOL 财库公司可能因此面临对其资产负债表承受能力及股价相对持仓折价的审视。
updates.market_impact_en: The transfers are routed to Coinbase Prime, an institutional trading and custody venue, so the roughly 1.25 million SOL represents a large, concentrated pool of sell-side supply for SOL over a short window. The unwind also feeds sentiment around the digital-asset-treasury model, where other listed SOL treasury holders are exposed to scrutiny over balance-sheet capacity and share-price discounts to holdings.

references.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI keeps board after shareholder... | The Block
Crypto Treasuries: Top Institutions Holding Digital Assets | CoinGecko

updates.title_zh: SkyAI已出售100万枚SOL套现1.07亿美元，持仓浮亏超1.6亿美元
updates.title_en: SkyAI已出售100万枚SOL套现1.07亿美元，持仓浮亏超1.6亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: SkyAI 披露已出售 100 万枚 SOL、套现约 1.07 亿美元，并表示可能继续出售；链上数据显示自 10 月初以来累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: SkyAI disclosed it has sold 1 million SOL for about $107M and signaled possible further sales; on-chain data now shows about 1.57M SOL (~$175M) moved out since early October, with unrealized losses exceeding $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis.
updates.current_state_zh: SkyAI 仍在持续清算其 SOL 储备：已披露出售 100 万枚 SOL 套现约 1.07 亿美元，并可能继续出售；链上累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元，原有回购 95% 股份的资金安排仍在推进。
updates.current_state_en: SkyAI remains in an ongoing SOL liquidation: it has disclosed selling 1 million SOL for about $107M and may sell further; on-chain outflows since early October total about 1.57M SOL (~$175M), with unrealized losses over $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis, while the previously announced buyback of 95% of shares continues to be funded.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SkyAI has sold 1 million SOL for roughly $107 million and signaled further sales, with on-chain data showing 1.57 million SOL (~$175M) moved out since early October and an unrealized loss exceeding $160 million on a ~$194 average cost basis.
updates.detailed_summary_en: SkyAI has sold 1 million SOL for roughly $107 million and signaled further sales, with on-chain data showing 1.57 million SOL (~$175M) moved out since early October and an unrealized loss exceeding $160 million on a ~$194 average cost basis.
updates.background_zh: 现金要约收购是向股东公开发出的、以固定价格在限定时间内用现金直接回购股份的要约。预融资权证赋予持有人以名义行权价取得股份的权利，其行权资金在发行时即已预付，这类工具常用于融资交易中。SkyAI此次披露之前，已有多家上市公司将大量SOL作为企业财库资产进行配置。
updates.background_en: A cash tender offer is a public offer to buy shares directly from holders for cash at a fixed price and for a limited time. A pre-funded warrant grants the holder the right to acquire shares at a nominal exercise price, with the funding effectively provided at issuance; such instruments are commonly issued alongside financing transactions. SkyAI's disclosure follows a period in which several listed companies accumulated large SOL positions as corporate treasury assets.
updates.market_impact_zh: 已披露的出售以及公司表示可能继续抛售，为SOL现货市场带来了可识别的新增卖方供给，而该持有方的财库头寸曾是规模最大的企业持仓之一。每股3.00美元的现金要约收购作用于股票与预融资权证层面，而非代币本身；逾1.6亿美元的未实现亏损规模，可能影响市场对企业SOL财库策略的情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: The disclosed sales and the company's stated willingness to keep selling put identifiable sell-side supply into SOL spot markets, where this holder's treasury position was one of the largest corporate ones. The separate $3.00-per-share cash tender offer affects the equity and pre-funded warrant side rather than the token, and the size of the unrealized loss is likely to weigh on sentiment toward corporate SOL treasury strategies.

references.title: An Overview of Pre-Funded Warrants - Lexology

updates.title_zh: SkyAI 近期大额抛售 SOL，大股东 Bastion Trading 质疑要约收购并要求全面披露
updates.title_en: SkyAI 近期大额抛售 SOL，大股东 Bastion Trading 质疑要约收购并要求全面披露
updates.what_changed_zh: 10月13日Form 8-K显示SkyAI的SOL持仓已降至约60万枚，较9月中旬“逾200万枚”减少约七成；持有约9.99%流通普通股的大股东Bastion Trading公开质疑公司10月11日宣布的每股3.00美元现金要约收购，要求立即全面披露SOL处置细节、启动独立审查、改组董事会，并将要约价提高至至少每股3.50美元，否则不会参与。
updates.what_changed_en: An Oct 13 Form 8-K shows SkyAI's SOL holdings have fallen to about 600,000, down roughly 70% from the 'over 2M' disclosed in mid-September; 9.99% holder Bastion Trading publicly challenged the company's Oct 11 $3.00/share cash tender offer, demanding immediate full disclosure of SOL disposals, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price of at least $3.50/share before it will participate.
updates.current_state_zh: SkyAI 仍在持续清算其 SOL 储备：已披露出售 100 万枚 SOL 套现约 1.07 亿美元，链上自 10 月初以来累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），8-K 显示持仓已降至约 60 万枚，按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元；公司 10 月 11 日宣布每股 3.00 美元现金要约收购以回购 95% 股份，但大股东 Bastion Trading 公开反对并要求全面披露、独立审查、改组董事会及提高要约价至至少 3.50 美元。
updates.current_state_en: SkyAI remains in an ongoing SOL liquidation: it disclosed selling 1M SOL for about $107M, on-chain outflows since early October total about 1.57M SOL (~$175M), an 8-K shows holdings down to ~600K SOL, with unrealized losses over $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis; its Oct 11 $3.00/share cash tender offer to buy back 95% of shares is now publicly opposed by 9.99% holder Bastion Trading, which demands full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher price of at least $3.50/share.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm SkyAI has offloaded roughly 1.75M SOL (~$175M) since early October, cutting holdings ~70% and crystallizing large losses, while 9.99% holder Bastion Trading is demanding full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price before supporting the company's cash offer.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm SkyAI has offloaded roughly 1.75M SOL (~$175M) since early October, cutting holdings ~70% and crystallizing large losses, while 9.99% holder Bastion Trading is demanding full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price before supporting the company's cash offer.
